tasha: Heads-up 10min. Drafting upgrade lanes for private installs when customers want us to touch networking. Proposing three lanes: locked-customer (no changes), assisted-run (SE/operator runs one-off changes), and autonomous-ops (opt-in operator automation). Feedback?

matt: quick clarification: autonomous-ops = installer can change routes/bgp/iptables automatically?

tasha: yes but gated. It performs config changes only after preflight and a signed approval token. Also only for tenants that enabled "autonomous-ops" in their tenancy profile.

kevin: what about secrets and ephemeral creds during automation? we must push them into customer KMS and emit entries to their audit log endpoint. No secrets in our logs.

ramona: agree on KMS + audit. also add preflight checks: ASN match, IP range collision check, MTU check, route-table capacity. If any fail, abort and surface a plain english reason.

matt: can you show the CLI / installer flag for opt-in? makes it easier to review UX.

tasha: draft CLI below:

```
# enable autonomy for tenant (requires netops approval token)
redwoodctl tenant enable-autonomy --tenant acme --approval-token ab12-xy

# run an assisted upgrade (operator present)
redwoodctl upgrade --tenant acme --mode assisted --se-session=token
```

kevin: nice. Also we should require a scheduled maintenance window for any autonomous changes (start_time/end_time) and a two-person approval: SE + customer netops or legal sign-off for some customers.

ramona: acceptance gates proposal: 20m health-check period post-upgrade, automated rollback if error-rate >3% or p99 latency increases by >7%, config-drift detection compares live config vs expected. Add KV cache warmup check: fail -> rollback to previous model variant.

matt: how fast is rollback? customers expect <2min rollback window for critical services. we need a fast path sequence.

tasha: propose fast-rollback runbook triggered by a single operator flag: `--rollback-now`. We'll document steps and include a postmortem template.

kevin: UX ask: installer must show this exact text before enabling autonomy: "Redwood will modify network configuration on your hosts. Changes will be auditable and can be revoked." Link to audit logs + manifest. No silent defaults.

ramona: also provide a local preflight binary customers can run that emits JSON with schema and an ASCII summary. Example output (escaped): {\"status\":\"fail\",\"errors\":[\"ASN mismatch\",\"MTU mismatch: 9000 != 1500\"]}. Keep it human-friendly.

legal: tagging in. We'll need a templated customer opt-in agreement and a risk matrix for autonomous operations. Send me the lane defs and approval flow.

tasha: thanks. action items: I'll update draft with full preflight schema, CLI examples, maintenance-window enforcement, rollback playbook, and a sample audit export. Will add Legal + Security review step before we flip autonomous-ops to GA. Circle back next Wednesday for sign-off.

deploy-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-private/priv-deploy/autonomy-lanes/1729999991-draft.md (owner: tasha)
thread_text: Drafting three upgrade lanes for private deployments (locked-customer, assisted-run, autonomous-ops). Discussed CLI flags, preflight checks, KMS/audit requirements, maintenance window and approval gates, rollback timing, KV cache warmup check, and Legal review.
